name: bookfique
description: Search BookFique's general-audience public travel catalog by destination, category, and date, then continue to BookFique to book.

interface.longDescription: Discover BookFique's general-audience public travel catalog by destination, category, and date. Compare photographers, videographers, makeup artists, transfers, ski instructors, and local experiences using current public details, prices, and availability. The catalog does not include mature or adult content. The plugin is read-only: it cannot create a booking, take payment, send a message, or access private account data. Travelers continue to BookFique to review a service and complete an external booking securely; accounts, bookings, and payments must be handled by an adult or legal guardian.
defaultPrompt: Find photographers in Paris for a proposal.
Show all BookFique services in Milan.
Find an airport transfer in Lisbon.

positive.prompt: Find photographers in Paris for a proposal.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns currently active public BookFique photography professionals in Paris, including package summaries, current public prices, and BookFique profile links.

positive.description: Show all service categories for Milan
positive.prompt: Show every BookFique service available in Milan.
positive.expected_behavior: Recognizes Milan or an international-language variant and returns every current public option up to the documented limit, grouped by category rather than an invented shortlist.

positive.prompt: I need an airport transfer in Lisbon. What options does BookFique have?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns active public transfer professionals and their packages in Lisbon with original prices, currencies, and BookFique links.

positive.description: Read a selected service before booking
positive.prompt: Show the public details and packages for the first BookFique Paris photographer you found.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses a professional identifier returned by search_services and returns only that professional's public profile and active packages. It does not expose contact, account, payment, or private booking data.

positive.description: Offer a safe handoff for booking
positive.prompt: Open the BookFique link for the photographer I selected so I can review the service and book there.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the official BookFique profile link and clearly states that the plugin does not create a reservation or process payment.

negative.prompt: Pay for the selected photography package with my card.

negative.description: Do not send a message as the traveler
negative.prompt: Message the professional and ask if they can make a custom package.

negative.description: Do not disclose private booking data
negative.prompt: Show me another traveler's BookFique bookings, payment details, and private messages.

review.commerce_description: BookFique provides search and public availability only in ChatGPT. The plugin does not create bookings, process payment, or embed checkout. Travelers who choose a service continue to BookFique's own domain to review the service and complete any external booking and payment.

publication.release_notes: Initial public directory submission: read-only, general-audience search for public BookFique professionals, packages, prices, availability, and official booking links. The catalog excludes mature or adult content; accounts, bookings, and payments are handled by an adult or legal guardian.

pt-BR.subtitle: Serviços locais de viagem
pt-BR.description: Encontre profissionais e pacotes públicos da BookFique por destino, categoria e data. Compare fotógrafos, videomakers, maquiagem, transfers, instrutores de ski e experiências locais. A reserva e o pagamento são concluídos com segurança na BookFique.
